title: PathwayAI Lyme disease burden evidence framework
citation: Zhang, Y. (2026). PathwayAI: Lyme disease burden evidence framework (Version 0.2.0) [Software and methods]. https://github.com/gaiju/pathwayAI/tree/burden-evidence-v0.2.0

source_applications.hook2022: Societal cost components and county illustrations, with study population and dollar year preserved.
source_applications.adrion2015: A separate 12-month medical-spending reference; never added to societal totals.
source_applications.johnson2014: Work changes and daily-activity topics in optional dated personal records; selected-survey percentages are not county disability probabilities.
source_applications.horn2025: Dated follow-up preparation and questions about continuing needs; three-month symptoms are not long-term disability.
source_applications.panel2016: Impact inventory and explicit perspectives, assumptions, uncertainty and provenance; adapted from the supplied summary rather than a claim of full cost-effectiveness analysis.

measures.measure: Published national societal-cost illustration: lower endpoint
measures.period: Annual national illustration published in Hook 2022
measures.interpretation: Author-reported historical illustration; not a current national measurement, lifetime total or confidence limit.

measures.measure: Published national societal-cost illustration: upper endpoint
measures.period: Annual national illustration published in Hook 2022
measures.interpretation: Author-reported historical illustration; not added to lower endpoint. Original national arithmetic is not recomputed here.
Includes medical, nonmedical and productivity components; not a lifetime total.

measures.measure: Adjusted excess total medical cost: Lyme group vs matched controls
measures.interpretation: Historical association; comparison groups differ. Do not sum with other references or use as current patient bills.

measures.measure: Adjusted excess cost within Lyme group: >=1 PTLDS-related code vs none
measures.interpretation: Historical association; comparison groups differ. Do not sum with other references or use as current patient bills.

county_illustrations.reported_cases_context: Dutchess, New York; FIPS 36027; 1,060 reported resident cases in 2024. Source: https://www.health.ny.gov/statistics/diseases/communicable/2024/docs/cases.pdf
county_illustrations.published_cost_context: USD 2,032.00 per participant/episode, 2016 dollars; medical, nonmedical and productivity costs. Hook et al. (2022): societal analysis n=613; reported cases in four high-incidence U.S. states; recruitment 2014–2016. Source: https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/28/6/21-1335_article
county_illustrations.calculation_assumptions: Reported cases × selected published unit cost. Transfer of study experience to the county is assumed. No underreporting or inflation adjustment. No local case-mix adjustment. Populations and periods differ. Keep medical, household and societal perspectives separate; do not add Yu and Hook totals or interpret their difference as savings.
county_illustrations.additional_burden_to_measure: Complete pre-diagnosis history; continuing costs and disability beyond the study horizon; separately measured caregiver time and valuation; and effects in populations excluded from the source. Some components are already included in a societal mean: identify overlap before adding any new cost.
county_illustrations.provenance: Cases: data/ny_lyme_cases_2024_verification.json, supplied NYSDOH PDF page 5. Costs: data/hook_2022_article_verification.json. See docs/burden_methodology.md; framework version 0.2.0.

impact_inventory.Available evidence: Hook societal medical component; Adrion claims-based costs; entered patient payments
impact_inventory.Coverage / next evidence needed: Different perspectives and horizons; current Lyme-specific county spending remains unmeasured.

impact_inventory.Available evidence: Optional personal cost records; part of Hook nonmedical costs
impact_inventory.Coverage / next evidence needed: Comparable local records and reporting periods; no representative county average.

impact_inventory.Available evidence: Missed workdays; optional valuation; Johnson selected survey
impact_inventory.Coverage / next evidence needed: Reduced hours, stopped work, reduced effectiveness and duration; prevent overlapping loss estimates.

impact_inventory.Available evidence: Optional hours entered in personal records
impact_inventory.Coverage / next evidence needed: Agreed time period and valuation method; no current county dollar estimate.

impact_inventory.Component: Daily function and quality of life
impact_inventory.Available evidence: Optional dated personal observations; Johnson survey; Horn follow-up
impact_inventory.Coverage / next evidence needed: Repeated, standardized measures; symptoms, limitations and benefits receipt are different outcomes.

impact_inventory.Available evidence: Selected illness studies; separate HRSA/Census all-cause context
impact_inventory.Coverage / next evidence needed: Appropriate probability, duration, affected population and incremental cost. Not estimated from three-month symptoms or selected-survey percentages.
